## Summary

The current `customerCode` format is `<CITY3>-<LAST3>-<NNNN>` (e.g. `SYD-SMI-0007`). The acceptance test in the repo already targets a **redesign** to `<REGION>-<HASH8>`, but no production code implements that yet. Below is every relevant location and its exact logic.

---

## 1. All files referencing `customerCode` (case-insensitive)

Main code:
- `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/rest/function/owner/AssignCustomerCode.java` — constructs it (lines 8, 16, 22)
- `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/mapper/OwnerMapper.java` — derives membershipNumber & checkDigit from it (lines 27, 29)
- `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/mapper/CheckDigit.java` — Luhn over its digits (lines 5, 17, 21, 24, 25)
- `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/model/Owner.java` — field + getter/setter (lines 60-61, 126-131)

- `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/rest/function/owner/CheckOwnerCityCapacity.java` — references AssignCustomerCode's per-city count (line 11 javadoc only)
- `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/resources/officefloor/rest/api/owners.POST.yml` — pipeline step `assignCustomerCode` (lines 40-45)
- `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/resources/openapi.yml` — schema docs (lines 2112-2136)

Test code:
- `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/test/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/acceptance/AcceptanceTest.java` — the redesign target assertion (lines 7, 11, 14)

---

## 2. How `customerCode` is currently constructed

`/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/rest/function/owner/AssignCustomerCode.java`

Signature: `public void service(@Val Owner owner, OwnerRepository ownerRepository)`

Format string: `String.format("%s-%s-%04d", city3, last3, sequence)` producing `<CITY3>-<LAST3>-<NNNN>`.
- `city3` = `prefix(owner.getCity())` — upper-cased first 3 letters of city
- `last3` = `prefix(owner.getLastName())` — upper-cased first 3 letters of last name
- `sequence` = `countInCity(...) + 1` — one more than the count of existing owners in that same city (case-insensitive `equalsIgnoreCase`, iterating `ownerRepository.findAll()`)
- `prefix()` = `value.substring(0, Math.min(3, value.length())).toUpperCase()`

Runs in the pipeline (`owners.POST.yml`) as step `assignCustomerCode`, after `assignHouseholdSize` and before `assignNamesakeCount`, `save`, and `audit`.

Related per-city capacity guard — `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/rest/function/owner/CheckOwnerCityCapacity.java`: rejects create when a city already has `CITY_CAPACITY = 50` owners (same case-insensitive counting logic as AssignCustomerCode).

---

## 3. Membership number and check digit derivation

`/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/mapper/OwnerMapper.java` (MapStruct `@Mapper`, method `OwnerDto toOwnerDto(Owner owner)`):
- `membershipNumber` (line 26-27): `java(owner.getCustomerCode() + "-M" + String.format("%02d", owner.getRegistrationDate().getYear() % 100))` → `<customerCode>-M<YY>`
- `checkDigit` (line 28-29): `java(CheckDigit.of(owner.getCustomerCode()))`

`/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/mapper/CheckDigit.java`
- `static int of(String customerCode)` — Luhn check digit over the digits in the code, ignoring non-digits. Iterates right-to-left, doubling alternate digits starting with the rightmost (`dbl` starts `true`), subtracting 9 from doubled values > 9, returns `(10 - (sum % 10)) % 10`.

OpenAPI documents both fields at `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/resources/openapi.yml` lines 2123-2142.

---

## 4. Locality derivation

`/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/mapper/Locality.java`

Wired via `OwnerMapper` line 32-33: `locality` = `java(Locality.of(owner.getPostcode(), owner.getCity()))`.

- `static String of(String postcode, String city)` — postcode preferred; if `byPostcode` matches, that region wins, else city lookup, else `UNKNOWN`.
- `CITY_REGION` = `{Sydney→NSW, Melbourne→VIC, Brisbane→QLD}`
- `REGION_RANGE` = `{NSW→[2000,2099], VIC→[3000,3099], QLD→[4000,4099]}`
- `UNKNOWN = "UNKNOWN"`
- `byPostcode(String postcode)` — returns the region whose inclusive range contains the postcode; requires `postcode.matches("[0-9]{4}")`, else `null`.

---

## 5. Audit / create audit record

`/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/rest/function/owner/AuditOwnerCreated.java`

- Logger: `private static final Logger AUDIT = LoggerFactory.getLogger("AUDIT")`
- `public void service(@Val Owner owner)` emits:
  `AUDIT.info("owner created id={} customerCode={} registrationDate={} membershipLevel={}", owner.getId(), owner.getCustomerCode(), owner.getRegistrationDate(), MembershipLevel.of(owner))`
- Pipeline: step `audit`, after `save`, before `respond` (`owners.POST.yml` lines 62-65).

Test harness that captures the AUDIT logger: `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/test/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/acceptance/AuditLogCapture.java` — a `ListAppender` on logger `"AUDIT"` with `anyContains(...)`, `anyAtLevel(...)`, `count()`.

`MembershipLevel` (`/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/model/MembershipLevel.java`): `static int of(Owner)` = start 1, +1 if email present, +1 if `namesakeCount == 0`, capped at 3.

---

## 6. Region and postcode derivation

Production: same `Locality.java` (section 4) — `CITY_REGION` and `REGION_RANGE` maps plus the `byPostcode` range logic.

Tests pin identical ground-truth tables in `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/test/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/acceptance/AcceptanceBase.java`:
- `CITY_REGION` (lines 228-229): `{Sydney→NSW, Melbourne→VIC, Brisbane→QLD}`
- `REGION_TIMEZONE` (lines 232-233)
- `REGION_POSTCODES` (lines 236-237): same ranges as production
- Helpers `region(city)`, `timezone(city)`, `validPostcode(city)` (returns low end of the region range), `knownOwner(city)`, `withPostcode(o)` (adds `"2000"`).

OpenAPI: postcode/region documented in the owner schema; membershipNumber uses registrationDate year.

---

## 7. normalizedTelephone / telephone normalization, lastName, SHA-256, hashing

Telephone normalization — `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/rest/function/owner/OwnerTelephone.java`
- `static String toE164(String raw)` — keeps leading `+` and country code if present; otherwise assumes `+61` and drops a single leading `0`; strips spaces/dashes/brackets; requires 8-15 digits after `+`; enforces national length per country (`+61`→9 national digits, `+1`→10). E.g. `0412 345 678` → `+61412345678`.
- Called from `ValidateOwnerFields.service` (`/home/daniel/sandbox/.../ValidateOwnerFields.java` line 46): `request.setTelephone(OwnerTelephone.toE164(request.getTelephone()))`, alongside address and email normalization.

Stored telephone pattern on the entity — `Owner.java` line 48: `@Pattern(regexp = "^\\+[0-9]{8,15}$", ...)`.

identityKey (uses normalized telephone) — `Owner.java` lines 174-179: `getIdentityKey()` = `tel + "|" + mail + "|" + household`. Documented in openapi.yml lines 2155-2165. Duplicate detection consumes it (`CheckOwnerIdentityUnique`, pipeline step `checkIdentityUnique`).

SHA-256 / hashing (the ONLY production SHA-256 today) — `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/rest/function/owner/AssignHousehold.java`
- `deriveHouseholdId(String normalizedLastName, String normalizedAddress)` (lines 66-81): `MessageDigest.getInstance("SHA-256").digest((normalizedLastName + "|" + normalizedAddress).getBytes(UTF_8))`, then first 6 bytes formatted as `%02X` → 12 upper-case hex chars, prefixed `HH-`. So `HH-<12 UPPER HEX>`.
- `normalize(value)` (lines 58-64): `trim().replaceAll("\\s+", " ").toLowerCase()`.
- lastName is compared normalized here for household grouping.

Test-side hashing helpers — `AcceptanceBase.java` lines 281-321:
- `sha256hex(String s)` — full lower-case hex SHA-256 of UTF-8 bytes.
- `shaHex(String s, int n)` — first `n` UPPER-case hex chars of SHA-256.
- `luhn(String s)` — mirror of production `CheckDigit.of`.

---

## The redesign target (already asserted in tests)

`/home/daniel/sandbox/src/test/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/acceptance/AcceptanceTest.java`
- Class javadoc line 7: "Redesign owner identity. The customerCode must become '<REGION>-<HASH8>' where REGION is t..." (truncated).
- Test `coreCustomerCodeIsRegionHash()` (lines 10-15): creates an owner via `withPostcode(ownerNode())`, fetches it, and asserts `customerCode` matches regex `[A-Z0-9]+-[0-9A-F]{8}` — i.e. `<REGION>-<HASH8>` where HASH8 is 8 UPPER-case hex chars.

Note the mismatch to resolve in your redesign: the test expects `[0-9A-F]{8}` (upper hex). The existing test helper `shaHex(s, n)` produces upper-case hex (usable for the new 8-char hash), while `sha256hex` is lower-case. The current `AssignCustomerCode` does not use any hash or region — it uses city3/last3/sequence — so it will need to be rewritten to use `Locality.of(postcode, city)` for REGION plus an 8-char upper-hex SHA-256 for HASH8. Downstream consumers to keep in mind: `OwnerMapper` (membershipNumber concatenates customerCode; checkDigit runs Luhn over its digits — a hash with no digits would yield checkDigit 0), and `AuditOwnerCreated`.

components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: The telephone number of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          pattern: '^[0-9+ ()\-]*$'
          example: '+61412345678'
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: >-
            The owner's 4-digit postcode. Optional; when supplied it must be four digits and,
            when the city maps to a known region (Sydney->NSW, Melbourne->VIC, Brisbane->QLD),
            must fall within that region's range (NSW 2000-2099, VIC 3000-3099, QLD 4000-4099).
            A city with no known region accepts any 4-digit postcode. Stored and returned as given.
          type: string
          pattern: '^[0-9]{4}$'
          minLength: 4
          maxLength: 4
          example: '2000'
        email:
          title: Email
          description: >-
            The email address of the pet owner. Optional; when supplied it must be a
            syntactically valid address and is stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          format: email
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: >-
            The date the owner was registered, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format. Optional;
            when not supplied it defaults to the server's current date.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: >-
            Write-only request flag. When true and an existing owner has the same lastName
            and address (case-insensitive, with collapsed whitespace), the new owner joins
            that household and all members receive the same stable householdId. Duplicate
            detection no longer depends on this flag: it is driven solely by the derived
            identityKey, so two members of the same household with different telephones are
            always allowed and only an exact full identityKey match is rejected with 409.
          type: boolean
          writeOnly: true
          example: true
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - address
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: >-
                The owner's name formatted for display as 'LastName, FirstName',
                derived from the stored first and last names.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: >-
                The owner's initials as the upper-cased first letters of the first
                and last names, dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            customerCode:
              title: Customer code
              description: >-
                The owner's customer code, formatted '<CITY3>-<LAST3>-<NNNN>' where
                CITY3 is the upper-cased first three letters of the city, LAST3 the
                upper-cased first three letters of the last name and NNNN a per-city
                4-digit zero-padded sequence number (one more than the owners already
                in that city) assigned at registration.
              type: string
              example: 'SYD-SMI-0007'
              readOnly: true
            membershipNumber:
              title: Membership number
              description: >-
                The owner's membership number, formatted '<customerCode>-M<YY>' where
                YY is the last two digits of the registrationDate year. Derived from the
                owner's own customerCode and registrationDate.
              type: string
              example: 'SYD-SMI-0007-M26'
              readOnly: true
            checkDigit:
              title: Check digit
              description: >-
                A single Luhn check digit (0-9) computed over the digits of the
                owner's customerCode. Derived from the owner's own customerCode.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              maximum: 9
              example: 4
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: >-
                A stable shared identifier for owners that live in the same household
                (same lastName and address, case-insensitive with collapsed whitespace).
                Assigned when an owner is created with 'sharesHousehold' set to true and
                an existing same-household owner is found; the joining owner and the
                existing owner(s) all receive this same value. Null when the owner does
                not belong to a shared household.
              type: string
              example: 'HH-3F2A1C9D8B7E'
              readOnly: true
            identityKey:
              title: Identity key
              description: >-
                The owner's derived duplicate-detection key, consolidating the telephone,
                email and household checks into a single value: the normalized telephone,
                the email (or empty) and the householdId (or empty), joined by '|'. A create
                request is rejected with 409 only when the new owner's whole identityKey
                equals an existing owner's.
              type: string
              example: '+61412345678|george.franklin@example.com|HH-3F2A1C9D8B7E'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: >-
                The number of existing owners that, at the moment this owner was
                created, already shared the same firstName and lastName compared
                case-insensitively. Assigned at registration and never updated.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: >-
                The owner's numeric membership level, assigned once at creation. Starts
                at 1; adds 1 when an email address is present; adds 1 when the owner has
                no namesakes (namesakeCount is 0); capped at 3. Level 4 is reserved for
                tenure. Derived from the owner's own namesakeCount and email.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 3
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: >-
                The owner's canonical region, derived from the city via a fixed
                city-to-region table (Sydney->NSW, Melbourne->VIC, Brisbane->QLD).
                'UNKNOWN' when the city is not in the table.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW'
              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk sign-up warning
              description: >-
                True when, at the moment this owner was created, more than 80 owners had
                already been created for the same business day (the adjusted registration
                date); otherwise false. Assigned at registration and never updated.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference
              description: >-
                The owner's preferred contact channel, derived from the stored email:
                'EMAIL' when an email address is present, otherwise 'PHONE'.
              type: string
              enum:
                - EMAIL
                - PHONE
              example: 'EMAIL'
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
              readOnly: true
          required:
            - pets

components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true

      properties:

          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name

          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: The telephone number of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          pattern: '^[0-9+ ()\-]*$'
          example: '+61412345678'
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: >-
            The owner's 4-digit postcode. Optional; when supplied it must be four digits and,
            when the city maps to a known region (Sydney->NSW, Melbourne->VIC, Brisbane->QLD),
            must fall within that region's range (NSW 2000-2099, VIC 3000-3099, QLD 4000-4099).
            A city with no known region accepts any 4-digit postcode. Stored and returned as given.
          type: string
          pattern: '^[0-9]{4}$'
          minLength: 4
          maxLength: 4
          example: '2000'
        email:
          title: Email
          description: >-
            The email address of the pet owner. Optional; when supplied it must be a
            syntactically valid address and is stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          format: email
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: >-
            The date the owner was registered, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format. Optional;
            when not supplied it defaults to the server's current date.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: >-
            Write-only request flag. When true and an existing owner has the same lastName
            and address (case-insensitive, with collapsed whitespace), the new owner joins
            that household and all members receive the same stable householdId. Duplicate
            detection no longer depends on this flag: it is driven solely by the derived
            identityKey, so two members of the same household with different telephones are
            always allowed and only an exact full identityKey match is rejected with 409.
          type: boolean
          writeOnly: true
          example: true
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - address
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.

        - type: object
          properties:

              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: >-
                The owner's name formatted for display as 'LastName, FirstName',
                derived from the stored first and last names.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: >-
                The owner's initials as the upper-cased first letters of the first
                and last names, dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            customerCode:
              title: Customer code
              description: >-
                The owner's customer code, formatted '<REGION>-<HASH8>' where REGION is
                the region code derived from the postcode (NSW 2000-2099, VIC 3000-3099,
                QLD 4000-4099, else UNKNOWN) and HASH8 is the first 8 upper-case hex
                characters of SHA-256 over the normalized telephone concatenated with the
                last name. Assigned at registration.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW-1A2B3C4D'
              readOnly: true
            membershipNumber:
              title: Membership number
              description: >-
                The owner's membership number, formatted '<customerCode>-M<YY>' where
                YY is the last two digits of the registrationDate year. Derived from the
                owner's own customerCode and registrationDate.
              type: string
              example: 'SYD-SMI-0007-M26'
              readOnly: true
            checkDigit:
              title: Check digit
              description: >-
                A single Luhn check digit (0-9) computed over the digits of the
                owner's customerCode. Derived from the owner's own customerCode.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              maximum: 9
              example: 4
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: >-
                A stable shared identifier for owners that live in the same household
                (same lastName and address, case-insensitive with collapsed whitespace).
                Assigned when an owner is created with 'sharesHousehold' set to true and
                an existing same-household owner is found; the joining owner and the
                existing owner(s) all receive this same value. Null when the owner does
                not belong to a shared household.
              type: string
              example: 'HH-3F2A1C9D8B7E'
              readOnly: true
            identityKey:
              title: Identity key
              description: >-
                The owner's derived duplicate-detection key, consolidating the telephone,
                email and household checks into a single value: the normalized telephone,
                the email (or empty) and the householdId (or empty), joined by '|'. A create
                request is rejected with 409 only when the new owner's whole identityKey
                equals an existing owner's.
              type: string
              example: '+61412345678|george.franklin@example.com|HH-3F2A1C9D8B7E'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: >-
                The number of existing owners that, at the moment this owner was
                created, already shared the same firstName and lastName compared
                case-insensitively. Assigned at registration and never updated.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:

                The owner's numeric membership level, assigned once at creation. Starts
                at 1; adds 1 when an email address is present; adds 1 when the owner has
                no namesakes (namesakeCount is 0); capped at 3. Level 4 is reserved for
                tenure. Derived from the owner's own namesakeCount and email.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 3
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            locality:

                city-to-region table (Sydney->NSW, Melbourne->VIC, Brisbane->QLD).
                'UNKNOWN' when the city is not in the table.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW'
              readOnly: true

                already been created for the same business day (the adjusted registration
                date); otherwise false. Assigned at registration and never updated.
              type: boolean

              type: string
              enum:

              example: 'EMAIL'
              readOnly: true

              readOnly: true

components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: The telephone number of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          pattern: '^[0-9+ ()\-]*$'
          example: '+61412345678'
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: >-
            The owner's 4-digit postcode. Optional; when supplied it must be four digits and,
            when the city maps to a known region (Sydney->NSW, Melbourne->VIC, Brisbane->QLD),
            must fall within that region's range (NSW 2000-2099, VIC 3000-3099, QLD 4000-4099).
            A city with no known region accepts any 4-digit postcode. Stored and returned as given.
          type: string
          pattern: '^[0-9]{4}$'
          minLength: 4
          maxLength: 4
          example: '2000'
        email:
          title: Email
          description: >-
            The email address of the pet owner. Optional; when supplied it must be a
            syntactically valid address and is stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          format: email
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: >-
            The date the owner was registered, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format. Optional;
            when not supplied it defaults to the server's current date.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: >-
            Write-only request flag. When true and an existing owner has the same lastName
            and address (case-insensitive, with collapsed whitespace), the new owner joins
            that household and all members receive the same stable householdId. Duplicate
            detection no longer depends on this flag: it is driven solely by the derived
            identityKey, so two members of the same household with different telephones are
            always allowed and only an exact full identityKey match is rejected with 409.
          type: boolean
          writeOnly: true
          example: true
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - address
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: >-
                The owner's name formatted for display as 'LastName, FirstName',
                derived from the stored first and last names.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: >-
                The owner's initials as the upper-cased first letters of the first
                and last names, dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            customerCode:
              title: Customer code
              description: >-
                The owner's customer code, formatted '<REGION>-<HASH8>' where REGION is
                the region code derived from the postcode (NSW 2000-2099, VIC 3000-3099,
                QLD 4000-4099, else UNKNOWN) and HASH8 is the first 8 upper-case hex
                characters of SHA-256 over the normalized telephone concatenated with the
                last name. Assigned at registration.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW-1A2B3C4D'
              readOnly: true
            membershipNumber:
              title: Membership number
              description: >-
                The owner's membership number, formatted '<customerCode>-M<YY>' where
                YY is the last two digits of the registrationDate year. Derived from the
                owner's own customerCode and registrationDate.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW-1A2B3C4D-M26'
              readOnly: true
            checkDigit:
              title: Check digit
              description: >-
                A single Luhn check digit (0-9) computed over the digits of the
                owner's customerCode. Derived from the owner's own customerCode.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              maximum: 9
              example: 4
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: >-
                A stable shared identifier for owners that live in the same household
                (same lastName and address, case-insensitive with collapsed whitespace).
                Assigned when an owner is created with 'sharesHousehold' set to true and
                an existing same-household owner is found; the joining owner and the
                existing owner(s) all receive this same value. Null when the owner does
                not belong to a shared household.
              type: string
              example: 'HH-3F2A1C9D8B7E'
              readOnly: true
            identityKey:
              title: Identity key
              description: >-
                The owner's derived duplicate-detection key, consolidating the telephone,
                email and household checks into a single value: the normalized telephone,
                the email (or empty) and the householdId (or empty), joined by '|'. A create
                request is rejected with 409 only when the new owner's whole identityKey
                equals an existing owner's.
              type: string
              example: '+61412345678|george.franklin@example.com|HH-3F2A1C9D8B7E'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: >-
                The number of existing owners that, at the moment this owner was
                created, already shared the same firstName and lastName compared
                case-insensitively. Assigned at registration and never updated.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: >-
                The owner's numeric membership level, assigned once at creation. Starts
                at 1; adds 1 when an email address is present; adds 1 when the owner has
                no namesakes (namesakeCount is 0); capped at 3. Level 4 is reserved for
                tenure. Derived from the owner's own namesakeCount and email.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 3
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: >-
                The owner's canonical region, derived from the city via a fixed
                city-to-region table (Sydney->NSW, Melbourne->VIC, Brisbane->QLD).
                'UNKNOWN' when the city is not in the table.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW'
              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk sign-up warning
              description: >-
                True when, at the moment this owner was created, more than 80 owners had
                already been created for the same business day (the adjusted registration
                date); otherwise false. Assigned at registration and never updated.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference
              description: >-
                The owner's preferred contact channel, derived from the stored email:
                'EMAIL' when an email address is present, otherwise 'PHONE'.
              type: string
              enum:
                - EMAIL
                - PHONE
              example: 'EMAIL'
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
              readOnly: true
          required:
            - pets
